text: As someone who values oral health, I recently visited the CDC Dental Clinic for routine teeth cleaning. A friendly and welcoming staff greeted me. They were smiling courteous, and made me feel comfortable throughout my appointment. The price was very affordable. I would recommend this dentist to others.
They provided excellent service, checking my eligibility twice, and I haven't had to pay anything yet.

text:
I wish the clinic would screen its doctors more carefully.
Some are lovely, but others are rude, heavy-handed, and get irritated with patients. Ideally, there should be information about the doctors on duty each day, and patients should have the option to choose their doctor. When scheduling an appointment, not knowing which day the doctor is available is risky.

I took my child to see an older female dentist for a check-up. The service was excellent.
She spoke politely, and the staff were also friendly and welcoming with smiles. Thank you!
